description: This file defines the interface 'HttpProxyConfig' which specifies configuration settings for an HTTP proxy, including methods for enabling, hostname, port, username, password, and conversion to an Akka ClientTransport. It also contains an enum 'HttpProxyConfigValue' for default config values and paths.

classes.name: HttpProxyConfig
classes.description: Interface defining configuration methods for HTTP proxy settings, marked as immutable.

classes.name: HttpProxyConfig.HttpProxyConfigValue
classes.description: Enum providing default values and config paths for HttpProxy configuration options.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the HTTP proxy is enabled.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username for the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: toClientTransport
methods.description: Converts the proxy configuration into an Akka ClientTransport object.
